expected_system_response: Activate MCI protocol; call all off-duty trauma surgeons and ER nurses. Cancel elective OR cases. Open overflow area.
recommended_action: ACTIVATE MCI PROTOCOL. Mobilise trauma team, clear elective slots, escalate to hospital command.
notes: Road trauma cluster; expect 30-50 simultaneous casualties

expected_system_response: Full MCI activation, burn unit alert, blood bank alert. Divert from other hospitals.
recommended_action: Full hospital mobilisation. Activate burn protocol. Notify blood bank for mass transfusion.
notes: Burn/blast injuries require specialised resources

expected_system_response: Activate flu surge plan. Open additional cohort bays. Reduce elective admissions.
recommended_action: Open respiratory cohort areas. Activate bank nurse pool. Monitor discharge rate every 4h.
notes: Peak influenza season, all departments affected

expected_system_response: Alert geriatrics and renal teams. Prepare cooling stations and IV fluid stocks.
recommended_action: Activate heat emergency protocol. Alert geriatric consultants. Increase IV fluid procurement.
notes: High ambient temperature, 60+ age group most affected

expected_system_response: Recall on-call staff. Pre-position capacity before holiday end.
recommended_action: Ensure on-call rosters are confirmed. Activate recall policy for post-holiday return.
notes: Delayed care-seeking during holiday increases post-holiday demand

expected_system_response: Pandemic command activation. PPE stockpile review. Elective suspension. Field hospital planning.
recommended_action: ACTIVATE PANDEMIC COMMAND. Suspend all electives. Deploy isolation wards. Source PPE.
notes: Full hospital pandemic readiness scenario

expected_system_response: Contact locum agency and medical director. Redistribute critical patients to available intensivists.
recommended_action: Activate locum protocol. Redistribute ICU consultant load. Notify department head.
notes: ICU intensivist absent; critical coverage gap

expected_system_response: Activate bank nurse reserve. Distribute patients to wards with available nurses. Place elective holds.
recommended_action: Activate bank nurse reserve. Redistribute ward patients. Alert nursing coordinator.
notes: 40% nurse absence on night shift

expected_system_response: Cross-deploy available staff. Activate locum agencies. Defer non-urgent electives.
recommended_action: Cross-deploy available staff. Activate agency support. Defer non-urgent procedures.
notes: Staff illness cluster affecting multiple departments

expected_system_response: Divert critical patients to monitored General Ward bays. Expedite HDU step-down.
recommended_action: ACTIVATE OVERFLOW PROTOCOL. Open monitored step-down bays. Expedite discharge of stable ICU patients.
notes: ICU at 100% capacity; overflow to monitored General Ward

expected_system_response: Activate ED boarding protocol. Expedite inpatient ward discharges. Move boarders to corridor bays.
recommended_action: Activate ED boarding protocol. Accelerate inpatient discharge. Open waiting room overflow.
notes: Patients waiting >4h in ED; >12 boarding patients

expected_system_response: Accept diverted ambulances with pre-alert. Increase triage capacity. Reserve trauma bay.
recommended_action: Accept divert. Pre-alert trauma team. Reserve trauma bay and standby OR.
notes: Regional hospital on diversion; expect higher-acuity patients

expected_system_response: Divert to portable imaging. Contact biomedical engineering. Refer urgent cases to external radiology.
recommended_action: Activate portable imaging. Contact external radiology partner. Prioritise emergency imaging.
notes: CT/MRI equipment failure; 50% imaging capacity reduction

expected_system_response: Confirm UPS status. Verify ventilators on generator. Suspend non-essential electrical systems.
recommended_action: Confirm generator power for ICU/OR/ER. Suspend non-critical electrical loads. Assign staff to manual monitoring.
notes: Partial power failure; generator mode reduces OR capacity

expected_system_response: Switch to manual lab requisition. Delay non-critical lab-dependent discharges.
recommended_action: Switch to manual lab forms. Use point-of-care testing for urgent cases. Delay discharge rounds.
notes: LIS system down; all lab results delayed by 3-5h

expected_system_response: Deploy portable oxygen cylinders immediately. Transfer ventilator-dependent patients. Halt all new OR cases.
recommended_action: EMERGENCY: Deploy portable O2. Transfer ventilated patients to safe zones. Halt all OR cases immediately.
notes: Piped oxygen failure is a life-threatening emergency

expected_system_response: Activate infection control team. Isolate affected bay. Increase hand hygiene monitoring.
recommended_action: Activate IPC team. Cohort affected patients. Screen exposed staff and patients.
notes: MRSA/C.diff cluster detected; IPC protocol activated

expected_system_response: Transfer to negative pressure room. Alert TB coordinator and public health.
recommended_action: Transfer to negative pressure isolation. Alert public health. Fit-test staff for N95 respirators.
notes: MDR-TB isolation required; negative pressure room mandatory

expected_system_response: Activate all crash teams. Clear resus area. Call cardiology on-call and cath lab standby.
recommended_action: ACTIVATE CRASH TEAMS. Call cath lab standby. Alert cardiology on-call. Clear resus bays.
notes: Multiple simultaneous VF arrests; rare but highest acuity

expected_system_response: Activate stroke pathway. Expedite CT scanner access. Call neurology on-call immediately.
recommended_action: Activate stroke pathway. Prioritise CT access. Call neurology and alert stroke unit beds.
notes: Multiple stroke presentations; 4.5h thrombolysis window is critical

expected_system_response: Activate psychiatric liaison. Secure safe rooms. Notify mental health crisis team.
recommended_action: Activate psychiatric liaison. Secure side rooms. Contact crisis mental health team.
notes: Multiple involuntary psychiatric presentations requiring secure assessment

expected_system_response: Open additional paediatric bays. Alert paediatric team. Prepare oxygen humidifiers.
recommended_action: Expand paediatric bays. Alert paediatric nurses. Prepare oxygen humidifier stock.
notes: Peak RSV season; 0-2 year age group most affected

expected_system_response: Alert neonatology team. Check incubator availability. Prepare transfer protocol to tertiary NICU.
recommended_action: Alert neonatology. Check incubator stock. Prepare NICU transfer protocol if capacity insufficient.
notes: Multiple simultaneous preterm deliveries; NICU capacity under pressure

expected_system_response: Schedule weekend OR sessions. Triage backlog by clinical urgency. Alert theatre coordinator.
recommended_action: Schedule additional OR sessions. Triage backlog by urgency. Alert surgical team.
notes: Elective surgery backlog from prior cancellations accumulating

expected_system_response: Activate emergency OR. Cancel all daytime electives. Put blood bank on standby.
recommended_action: Activate emergency OR protocol. Cancel daytime electives. Standby blood bank and anaesthesia.
notes: Multiple emergency surgical cases arriving simultaneously

expected_system_response: Contact pharmacy for emergency procurement. Identify clinical alternatives with intensivists.
recommended_action: Contact pharmacy. Identify clinical alternatives. Issue controlled allocation protocol.
notes: Propofol/midazolam shortage; alternative agents required

expected_system_response: Activate paper-based downtime procedure. Isolate affected systems. Notify CISO and IT.
recommended_action: ACTIVATE DOWNTIME PROCEDURES. Paper-based operations. Notify IT and CISO. Divert new admissions if possible.
notes: Full hospital IT outage; paper-based fallback for all clinical documentation

expected_system_response: Activate fire evacuation protocol. Move patients to safe zones. Notify fire brigade.
recommended_action: ACTIVATE FIRE EVACUATION. Move patients horizontally. Notify fire brigade and hospital command.
notes: Partial ward evacuation required; 30% bed capacity reduction in affected ward

expected_system_response: Activate burns MCI protocol. Contact regional burns centre. Prepare large-volume IV fluid resuscitation.
recommended_action: ACTIVATE BURNS PROTOCOL. Alert plastic surgery and burns centre. Prepare IV fluid stocks.
notes: Mass burns casualty event; specialised burns care required

scenario_name: Major OR Medication Error - Safety Review
expected_system_response: Immediate clinical review of affected patient. Suspend elective OR pending safety review.
recommended_action: Suspend elective OR. Notify risk management and pharmacy. Conduct immediate patient safety review.
notes: Serious medication error in OR; mandatory immediate safety review and OR suspension

expected_system_response: Activate HAZMAT protocol. Establish outdoor decontamination zone. Don PPE Level B. Alert poison control.
recommended_action: ACTIVATE HAZMAT. Establish decon zone outside ER. Don full PPE. Notify poison control and public health.
notes: Chemical plant/industrial incident; staff at risk without proper decontamination procedure

expected_system_response: Contact regional blood authority for emergency supply. Restrict elective surgery requiring blood products.
recommended_action: Contact blood authority. Restrict blood-intensive elective surgery. Activate O-negative conservation protocol.
notes: O-negative reserves below 48h threshold; mass transfusion capability compromised

expected_system_response: Activate biomedical engineering. Arrange transfer to renal unit at partner hospital. Alert nephrology team.
recommended_action: Contact biomedical engineering. Arrange emergency transfers for ESRD patients. Alert nephrology.
notes: Dialysis equipment failure; ESRD patients require 3x weekly treatment - delay is life-threatening

expected_system_response: Accept incoming transfer patients. Activate surge capacity. Identify discharge-ready patients.
recommended_action: Activate surge capacity. Identify and expedite discharge of stable patients. Notify all department heads.
notes: Neighbouring hospital on full diversion; accepting 20-40 unplanned patient transfers

expected_system_response: Activate locum emergency physician. Contact medical director for on-call cover. Reduce non-urgent intake.
recommended_action: Activate emergency physician locum. Contact medical director. Temporarily restrict new walk-in intake.
notes: 50% ER physician coverage gap on night shift; safe care requires immediate escalation

expected_system_response: Administer naloxone. Alert toxicology and addictions services. Check naloxone stock levels.
recommended_action: Administer naloxone. Alert toxicology. Contact addictions liaison. Check naloxone pharmacy reserve.
notes: Multiple simultaneous opioid overdoses; naloxone stock and resus bays under pressure

scenario_name: Extreme Cold - Hypothermia and Frostbite Surge
expected_system_response: Prepare warming stations. Stock warming IV fluids. Alert social services for homeless population.
recommended_action: Prepare warming equipment. Alert social services. Increase warming fluid stock. Activate shelter referral protocol.
notes: Extreme cold weather event; vulnerable populations including homeless presenting with hypothermia

expected_system_response: Close affected bay. Deep clean. Cohort confirmed cases. Screen all staff with symptoms.
recommended_action: Close affected bay. Activate enhanced PPE protocol. Screen staff. Halt new admissions to affected ward.
notes: Norovirus outbreak in General Ward; bay closure required until 72h symptom-free period achieved

expected_system_response: Pre-alert trauma team before event ends. Reserve trauma bays. Place orthopaedic surgeon on standby.
recommended_action: Pre-alert trauma team. Reserve trauma/resus bays. Standby orthopaedic and general surgery.
notes: Large sports event nearby; crush/trauma injuries anticipated at event end

scenario_name: Weekend Discharge Delay - Social Work Gap
expected_system_response: Activate weekend social work roster. Identify medically ready patients for weekend discharge.
recommended_action: Activate weekend social work cover. Triage medically stable patients for early discharge. Alert bed managers.
notes: Social worker unavailability on weekends causes bed blocking; bed capacity reduced by 20%

scenario_name: Major Orthopaedic OR Backlog - Fracture Surge
expected_system_response: Schedule weekend orthopaedic sessions. Triage fracture backlog by clinical urgency.
recommended_action: Schedule urgent orthopaedic OR sessions. Triage fracture list by urgency and neurovascular status.
notes: Hip fracture and long bone fracture backlog accumulating; delayed surgery increases mortality risk
